notes.title: Achievements are here!
notes.notes:
It took me a long time, but your support and voice motivated me to finish this task - now all 23 achievements are tested and available by playing the campaign and Roguelike mode!

The good news doesn't end here

Making games as solo-dev is hard and after more than a year of Early access I burnt out, So the GwenBlade as you see today and back on full release is not what I wanted to make, but a version with cut corners. 

So I decided to add new things in the following update, What  I assure you will be added is 
[list]
[*] New abilities (such as double jump)
[*] Ending scenes for every patient
[*] More dialogues
[*] Quality of life changes
[/list]

I hope you are excited and will give GwenBlade another playthrough 
Thank you so much for your love and support

notes.title: FeedBack Update^^~
notes.notes:
Big shotout to Ian Mitchell from GwenBlade's discord server. Most of the changes were done because of his incredible feedback^^~ Thank you so much Ian!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Weapon substats are reworked!

Substats are Speed, Radius, CritChance and CritRate and previously they were set randomly.
This means that when you getting new weapon it can have lower substat and because of that useless. Although rough Damage would always higher

Now it's remade and new system always make 2 substat better and 2 substat worse. 

[*]Knife are fixed and give bonus +10% to your attack (so 5 knifes is +50%)
[*]Execution now work at greater radius and if you see F on enemy you will definetely execute him
[*]bug with roguelike mode that will boot you the menu after 12th floor is fixed. For those who don't know after 12th floor there is new biome
[*]I'm planning to retexture some enemies to make thier looks more distinct, but for now i just make healthbars always visible and target icon more flashy
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*]Note are needed to execute enemies and to teleport to them(with upgrade in the shop)
[*]teleport now have built in 1 second of i-frames and also demolish enemy's armour. So basically you can take off shield and 50% of health by pressing to buttons, but it cost you 2 notes
[*]V-sync added to settings
[/list]

There is some criticism that hasn't been addressed like ControllerSupport, Tutorial system and other things. Some issues will be fixed in the next update, however it will be mostly concentrated on new content like levels, dialogues and cutscenes.

I'm looking forward to hear you feedback to improve the game make you happier^^~
Stan tuned:3

notes.title: New Biome Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Biome[/h1]

Climb higher and higher to fight Sorrow boss and be released from the nightmare.
In New Biome called "Taking Control" you will experience a new spin on GwenBlade's formula. Whole Biome is one level that procedurally generates with Corridors, Arenas, Shops and optional Boss Battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/5bb41b7479dd79372cb819c59a3d36070c202022.png[/img]

Now you can't choose your reward for every encounter, and instead you gain Happiness that you can spend on Upgrades.

For this update only this biome will be starting Biome so you can try it right away. In the next Update it will be put in the second one, as it was initially intended.

Also, every level (all 19th of them) from the first Biome were recolored to look more like the one Biome.

[h1]New boss and music theme for boss battles[/h1]

Guilt boss from the last story update is now in Roguelite mode! It placed in the end of the new Biome and ready to be fight with! In the next update it will go to the 12th floor of the first Biome.

So Pressure bossfight it's now on 24st floor and Distrust is moved on 36th floor. It means that there are new, 12 encounters were added! But can you reach that far?

And all three bosses have a new music theme that emphasizes how far you've come. It sounds dramatic, pressuring but with a little glimpse of hope - i'll love it!

[h1]Future[/h1]

I am planning on redesign enemy looks and AIs to make their idea more clear - every enemy emphasizes different negative emotion. 

Also adding new rewards for "Taking Control Biome" so it would make things more spicy. For example new weapons and abilities that you can unlock only in this biome and nowhere else.

And after the Next Update will be Story update with new level. Right now i'm not sure with character it will be - most likely Debora.

...

In the end i wanna say just to things - Thank you and Sorry

Thank you for playing and you feedback, all updates are for benefit to the players.

And sorry that this update took so long.

notes.title: Story Update #2 Julia
notes.notes:
[h1]Story Content[/h1]

5 scenes added to the Game that explore world and characters of GwenBlade. And 3 of them dedicated to Julia a new mysterious Character

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/8fe4fc761a31d7414b7b20c845287d236083e876.png[/img]

She is heartbroken and hopeless, closed from everyone and maybe, just maybe you can help her.
Try to light up, show hope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/c70d2595a6d8f139fb974822fcd4e4a604b9a67d.png[/img]

Julia's Soul - a lonely island in lightless night, just in a center of vast dark ocean.

[h1]Mechanics[/h1]

Roguelite and Campaign now has a different memory slots

New Mechanic added - a Self rating! It goes up when dealing damage and defeating foes. It's increases amount of happiness that you receive

Now range weapons don't consume notes to shoot

Abilities don't consume motivation, but notes instead. Cooldown time for abilities is now increased.

Basic enemies can drop weapons with a miniscule chance of 1% (as a reminder - bosses and minibosses drop weapons with a 100% chance)

notes.title: Halloween Costume and Combat Update^^~
notes.notes:
[h1]Costumes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/4847dc441466a742543c5a4c25fef5f48e2abc2d.png[/img]

Witch is Jane's Helloween costume form previous year. It was made with help from her Debora, that you save in introduction of Campaign. You will get to know her better in future Updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/c0f13151610b1639c92f491d251c05c1f611b249.png[/img]

Rogue costume is based on Gwenever - Jane's DnD character.

Costumes will be completely free for this Update, and later become purchasable in the game (for misery like other powerups between runs). The reason why they not selling now is there is no gameplay benefit from them. In the next Update with every costume there would be an artifact that you can wear. More About it Later^^~

[h1]Combat[/h1]

New attack animations both for Sword and Scythe weapons to make your combat [u]more flashy and impactful[/u].
New mechanic - [b]Charge attack[/b]. Now you can charge a button to make a more powerful attack [i]with your melee weapon[/i].

[b]Range weapons were rebuilt[/b]. Now the main focus of range weapons, [u]it's drain enemy's defense[/u], so your melee attacks will deal more damage.
Now [b]Bow [/b]has 3 different animations to wear down enemies in convincing fashion. 
[b]BlunderTrombone [/b](ShotGun) was reworked and now shots 6 projectiles with random spread, This shots summary damage more than Bow, but destroys on contact. So Shotgun is better at single target.

Breaking infusion is removed from the game. All it's feature now work in range Wepons.

Wind Infusion! New infusion that proc previous infusion. For example, if previous infusion on the enemy was Doom, than by hitting in with wind, doom will proc again. 

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Invisible cabel was fixed and now he is renders just fine.
Gravity in attacks were reworked. In previous Update it was possible just to fly in the air by attacking, Now gravity forces are stronger put you on the ground faster.

[h1]Future[/h1]

Next Update will be called Witchcraft Update and will greatly expand on ability system, both adding new abilities and making their obtain more meaningful.

notes.title: Weapons and Talents UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/271592f3ee98e7a1578b80fb241cacf792867932.png[/img]

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

There is a 5 weapons in the game
[list]
[*] [b]Treble Clef Sword[/b] - old reliable weapon with medium range and speed
[*] [b]Alto Clef Bow[/b] - good for dealing damage at great distances
[*] [b]Bass Clef Scythe[/b] - Slower weapon with larger swings
[*] [b]Blunder Trombone[/b] - Great for staggering and dealing huge damage
[*] [b]Electric Guitar[/b] - Shockingly good, but have restricted mobility
[/list]

Each weapon has a unique moveset of animations/
There is main weapons on LMB and range weapons at RMB that uses notes to shoot

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/b1108ef2567c368e8b9d46d2fd9ee7326b4bb89a.png[/img]

Weapons are dropping [u]from every boss[/u] (arenas 5.10.12.15.20.24) and have [b]3 stats[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage[/b] - it's a multiplier of base damage of the weapon. [i]This stat is always higher on the new weapon.[/i]
[*] [b]Speed[/b] - it's a multiplier of base animation speed and downtime between hits. [i]This stat has random nature[/i]
[*] [b]Range[/b] - Multiplier of swing size. [i]This stat has random nature[/i]
[/list]

Overall, it's freshens the gameplay and make boss battles more meaningful, cause you getting sweet new weapon for your arsenal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/72de9bb908f2a723030b4d26074c969ee1e1cf80.png[/img]

[h1]Talents[/h1]

Misery - it's negative energy and you better use it than collect it yourself. 

Same way it works in GwenBlade where your Miseries are fuel to become better!
Bad experience is still experience^^~

Right now you can increase your Max health, get more MOTIVATION, Damage and learn new tricks to deal with stress more efficiently!

...

Overall this update include all groundwork for new weapons and talents, that would be implemented with every new Update. 

I'm solodev and trying my best, and welcome any feedback!

Weekly Updates will be coming!

notes.title: Bash-Bash Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]New abilities [/h1]

Ability system was once again changed. Now you need a Motivation to cast spells an it's 20 points for every ability. Also now Motivation isn't passively regaining, and instead you need to hit enemies to get any. At the same time, now you don't need motivation to dash, walljump and block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/d69c4d9fbd015e7433935fac6d2c9351f23d1e3b.png[/img]
[b][u]Burst of Heal[/u][/b]

Heals you up to 20% of health and deal damage to nearby enemies at the same time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/5895bd18be948ebbc4058f0391cae04d2997403b.png[/img]
[b][u]Dragon Fly[/u][/b]

Launches a big fire ball that burns enemies

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/6d85ba5a801ae649ac9e84fa5978476fe272b68c.png[/img]
[b][u]Chain Note[/u][/b]

Note flying and slashing every enemy on arena

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/31549de27c0038bd053dfdb773aefc03a6857623.png[/img]
[b][u]LightStrike[/u][/b]

Lightning strike and make area dealing Break that exists enemy's energy and increases your damage

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

[b][u]Damage[/u][/b]
Now all enemy damage is clamped to 25 hit points. It was to fix 2 issues
Firstly, there is no one shot kills in late roguelite sessions
Secondly, Max health upgrade always grants a player +25 hit points, there for every time it's at least 1 more hit that you can take, cause previously in late game +25 meant nothing impactful

[b][u]New enemy - Impatience[/u][/b]

Impatience is airborne enemy that shoots laser at a player once in a while. Also his laser could damage other enemies too.

[b][u]Note system[/u][/b]

Notes needed for a range attacks on RMB input. And previously there was max 10 notes at a time.
[list]
[*] default max amount of notes is changed from 10 to 4
[*] Now you can increase it with new Reward
[*] Also Notes UI was enhanced and about it later in a post
[/list]

[b][u]Bugs fixed[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] damage formula for abilities was incorrect and all skills was dealing crazy damage in result. Now their damage is high as intended
[*] Many enemies become static while being constantly attacking - it was oversight in a code, and now, they actively would prevent you from hitting them by attacking you.
[*] Happiness(currency in a game) formula had also an oversight, so in a result it was really hard to buy anything in the shop. Now all of it balanced
[/list]

[h1]UI enhancements[/h1]

Pretty basic stuff, now if you don't have enough motivation, or spell is not ready or you don't have enough Notes than you would be greeted with the sound and Warning that you don't have any of this, 
Also motivation bar and Note bar had a subtle animation have a subtle animation at this events to make clear with thing you need at this moment.

[h1]Future Updates[/h1]

This update was planned to be bigger and later, but after feedback that i get, i decided to launch a balance patch. At the same time some amount of work was done and it's now included in this patch

I am planning to add in the next update

[list]
[*] Weapons system - Bosses and minibosses would drop a new weapon that you can take. Right now there is three melee weapons that fully modeled and animated - Sword, Guitar and Scythe and two range weapons - Bow and Blunderbass. Every new weapon would be different in moveset and in stats (Damage, Speed, Reach). Game would motivate to change weapon cause the new weapons would be always better in some stats.
[*] More abilities and new Infusions!
[*] End of the first mission and fully ready second mission. Also a return of old story levels
[/list]

I working on this mostly as solodev with sometimes taking help with the music, so the next update could not include every thing in that list, However i would launch it in the next 7 days, so there would be always incentive to launch a GwenBlade again^^~

notes.title: Huge Roguelite and Story update!
notes.notes:
[h3][u]Discord server[/u][/h3]

Our cozy and welcoming corner for a community, when we discuss GwenBlade^^
link: https://discord.gg/pxR5bne9

[h1][b][u]Story and lore[/u][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/bb1318ce908f76ed78437bbe1ed1cf9a3b294a23.png[/img]

The previous story line was [b]scraped out[/b] and a new one was made. 
Right now there is a first prologue and the first mission without an ending. I have a lot of plans and would add and ending and other cutscenes to deliver more information about the awesome world of GwenBlade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/23eecc5a6d5e307e4e7753d543be96353aef1979.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/c151c872ed034eaecd07c58d28473ea984e2d84e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/338ef84fbeaebb48a7dc0d73c64b5bd7df663881.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Mechanics[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][u]Abilities[/u][/h3]
Fully remade. Now abilities don't have a cooldown and manacost, instead each one has it's own unique bar and refill by inflicting damage and [u]executing[/u] an enemy. Abilities are now having their own infusions for example:
[u]Drill[/u] has a [u]Needles[/u], so every new tick of damage is higher.
of
[u]Eye of the Storm[/u] has a [u]Lightning[/u], so every time it hits there is lightning jumping between enemies.
Also, they have their own basic damage.
Instead of taking RMB, Q, E or R inputs they laying on 1 2 3 4 buttons. You can choose where to put new skill when equipping it.

In future there would be an option to change abilities mapping at any given moment in the game, and also adding more information about every ability, and more abilities variety.

[h3][u]Execution and motivation bar[/u][/h3]

It's fully new mechanics.
Motivation it's like an armor. so if an enemy has 100% of motivation, then your damage, it's 50% lesser and if 0% then your damage is 50% higher. It's reflected under enemy's healthbar.

Also, if enemy has 5% motivation or less then you can execute him by dealing him 50% of damage plus 1000 damage aoe. It also replenishes your abilities faster and heals you a bit.

[h3][u]Lightning and Breaking[/u][/h3]

Slowing and Healing as infusions now deleted cause they were to cheesy.

[u]Lightning[/u] is jumping throw enemies and dealing damage.

[u]Breaking[/u] decreases enemy's motivation

More Infusions in future

[h3][u]New top-down camera[/u][/h3]

Now in top-down mode (which is applied to specific levels) you can rotate camera in 2 axes, and levels were adapted by deleting background Building (camera used to clip in them) 

Now there is now Sidescroller camera, but the new top down camera could use in this perspective too.

[h3][u]Block and parry system[/u][/h3]

Now it's on Q-input. By holding Q you're blocking incoming damage and using your motivation for that. But if you time it right (0.2 seconds before taking damage) then Jane would make powerful explosion by parrying incoming attacks!

Also try pressing Q with projectiles near you - it would launch back at enemy^^~

[h3][u]NoteShootingMechanic[/u][/h3]

Now by pressing RMB - you shoot a note. Notes are dropping upon death of every enemy.

[h3][u]Visuals[/u][/h3]

Overall, there were a couple changes in rendering setting and shaders to make more slick and catchy look of aquaric comic.

[b]Added a scaling for enemy damage[/b], cause in previous patches it was to easy to play without taking HP max boost.

.............................................................................

That's it for now! I hope you excited for this Update! And the next would not take long and i be sure to deliver it within 10 days^^

see ya!

notes.title: Endless Rogulite Update! Working on Unreal Engine 5^^
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/4043c74191fc50e52a3f793f60cd4a05c944573c.png[/img]

I'm so happy by delivering this update! I hope you would be too, and have some tense and thoughtful fights in DreamLike Roguelite!

[b]SHOP [/b]
As you can see there is a Shop as a room between Rogulite arenas, here you can exchange your Happiness to make you stronger but all powerups are for the current run. So choose wisely how to spend your goodies^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/e68cb78da3ab54e183ca8ebd0e6e2f148beb481c.png[/img]

This paw signals you that after this Door there would be shop!

Now there is more Rewards in Roguelite and more possibilities for deck building! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/f973a79fc7b102adcfaa3bf55c9518cb6cfd2fee.png[/img]

Suffering and Happiness system was changed. After dying you get a 25 suffering for every 100 happiness that you have, to make the balancing act of them more controllable we added them as rewards after completing an encounter. 

Also there is Key that now only heals you a 10% of your health and they would stay after you died in the run. But sadly there is no use for them untill the next update.

[b]INFUSIONS[/b]

There is 5 Infusiable moves:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/6106c4a8a9894ca9b88fb3bbc57cde40171f87ec.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Ability
[*] Dash
[*] Jump
[*] Kill
[*] Attack
[/list]

Upon using any of this moves or killing enemy there would spawning hitbox that would inflict certain status. Or in the case of ability - there would be not any additional hitboxes and statuses would inflict upon hitting the enemy

There is five statuses that you could inflict

[list]
[*] Heal - Pink (Would heal you in certain Amount)
[*] Freeze - White Green (would slow all enemy's moves)
[*] Fire - Red (Would burn enemy)
[*] Doom - Orange (Would spawn explosion that makes aoe Damage)
[*] Needle - Ultramarine (Every new attack with a needle would make more Damage)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/fec3a88aa92089e77e467d7a2703968bfc8af355.png[/img]

If you already have an infusion on certain move, then their levels would be summarized. Either you like to upgrade only one move or to inflict as many as possible - is up to you!

They all makes gameplay and decision making more thoughtful and enjoyable! To do that you every run is different - there is one free Infusion at the Hub. Here is how it's looking like 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41758498/0787472a37b14b514fe2cf36bd14e1a8cf09ea8a.png[/img]

notes.title: Combat Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Combat Update[/b] made to address flaws in combat mechanics:

-Added new mechanic "[b]Motivation[/b]"
"Motivation" is a valuable resource needed to perform all special moves such as Blink, Dash, and Note Wave. Jane gets MOTIVATED by attacking her fears and devastating emotions by simple attacks (Left Mouse Button).
-Block/Parry mechanic rework from the ground up.
Hit will be blocked if Jane has enough motivation to handle an attack(1 motivation to 2 hit points). If Jane is not motivated enough part of the damage will slip through.
There is a parry - if you press Q and get hit in the next 0.2 seconds then the attack will be paired with devastating damage to the enemy
-Simple attacks don't stagger most of the enemy, and the player can't trade hits in his favor.

-An introduction before the first level

Thank you!^^~
